title: defense-evaluator output
description: Structured output from the defense-evaluator skill

introduction.description: Student introduced themselves and stated the topic

relevance.description: Relevance / importance of the topic was explained

goals_and_tasks.description: Goals and tasks were clearly formulated

results.description: Concrete results with data were presented

conclusion.description: Conclusion with practical significance was provided

matches_stated_topic.description: Content aligns with the stated thesis topic

key_results_covered.description: All key results from the thesis were mentioned

omissions.description: Significant omissions from the thesis not mentioned in the presentation

material_command.description: How well the student commands the material

specificity.description: Level of concrete data, facts, examples

contradictions_found.description: Whether contradictions between presentation and thesis were found

contradictions.description: List of contradictions between the presentation and the thesis

reviewer_remarks_addressed.description: Whether supervisor/reviewer remarks were addressed in the presentation

additional_questions.description: Additional questions generated from the presentation analysis

overall_impression.description: Overall impression of the defense presentation
